name: global-law
description: Read the law of nearly every country on earth as it stood on any date, see which law changed each provision and when, and check legal citations, through Lexifina's free hosted Global law MCP server (no account or key). Every answer cites the official text.

interface.shortDescription: Read the law of 200+ countries as it stood on any date
interface.longDescription: Global law reads any provision as in force on any date, names the law behind each change and checks legal citations, through the free hosted Global law MCP server. Every answer cites the official text and says where the record starts and ends.
defaultPrompt: What did Article 1 of the German Basic Law say on 1 January 1950?
